def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # drop exact duplicate rows
    df = df.drop_duplicates().reset_index(drop=True)
    # fix island label variants (extra spaces)
    df['island'] = df['island'].astype(str).str.strip()
    # body_mass_g stored as text (with commas) -> numeric
    df['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(
        df['body_mass_g'].astype(str).str.replace(',', '', regex=False).str.strip(),
        errors='coerce'
    )
    # fix obvious unit error: values like 3800000 / 3150000 should be grams * 1000
    mask = df['body_mass_g'] > 6500
    df.loc[mask, 'body_mass_g'] = df.loc[mask, 'body_mass_g'] / 1000
    # out-of-range body mass -> NaN
    df.loc[(df['body_mass_g'] < 2500) | (df['body_mass_g'] > 6500), 'body_mass_g'] = pd.NA
    # flipper_length_mm may be text; parse and fix out-of-range (negative) values
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = pd.to_numeric(df['flipper_length_mm'], errors='coerce')
    df.loc[(df['flipper_length_mm'] < 170) | (df['flipper_length_mm'] > 235), 'flipper_length_mm'] = pd.NA
    return df

def answer(df):
    d = clean(df)
    d = d[d['sex'].notna() & (d['sex'].astype(str).str.strip() != '')]
    d = d[d['body_mass_g'].notna()]
    means = d.groupby(d['sex'].astype(str).str.strip())['body_mass_g'].mean()
    return {str(k): round(float(v), 2) for k, v in means.items()}
